title: 6 Things a Godly Man Owes the Brothers Actually in His Corner
caption:
"Iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens another." Proverbs 27:17.

Not the group chat. Not the guys who like your posts. The two or three who actually have your number and would notice if you went quiet.

They're owed more than a reply. Tell them the truth even when it costs the easy friendship. Show up when it's inconvenient. Ask the question they're hoping you won't. Forgive faster than the world says you should. Pray for them by name.

Let them see you fail, not just win. That's where the sharpening actually happens.
